thread:
laura: quick ping — spotted 2 broken links on the observability playground and an SDK snippet that uses a removed API. planning to open a small PR. :wave:

docs-checker-bot: link-scan: /console/playground/cache -> 404, /docs/examples/tracehook-old -> 404. severity: medium.

laura: current snippet (on the page):

```
# python
from redwood import ConsoleClient
client = ConsoleClient()
client.cache_fetch_prefix('user_42', limit=100)
```

laura: new SDK uses `cache_get_many` and returns a list of items with per-item latency. suggested replacement:

```
# python
items = client.cache_get_many('user_42', max_items=10)
# items -> [{"key":"s", "value":"...", "fetch_ms":4}, ...]
```

cheng: thanks. note: the cost example on that page does `sum(latencies.values())` which expects a dict. we'll need a one-line compat shim or update the cost calc.

navya: propose adding a tiny compat snippet so older consumers can follow until they update production code:

```
# compatibility shim to convert new list -> old dict shape
lat_map = {it['key']: it['fetch_ms'] for it in items}
cost_ms = sum(lat_map.values())
```

laura: good idea. also adding redirect frontmatter for the missing page in case it moved:

```
---
redirect_from:
  - /console/playground/cache
---
```

patch-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5077 (title: "playground: replace cache_fetch_prefix with cache_get_many, add compat shim & redirects"). includes updated snippet, compat example, frontmatter redirect, and link-check CI.

emil: small ask: attach a 320x120 trace screenshot that highlights the new `key` and `fetch_ms` span attrs — helps marketing QA and support triage. otherwise looks good.

laura: will attach screenshot and add a one-line changelog at top of the playground page about the SDK rename. assigning reviewers now, will merge after CI + quick pair review. :+1:
